(☉_☉)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 37 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Lava''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] which only appeared on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It has mediocre health for its debut and has average speed. However, its main ability is to heal 15% of its health back every second. If left undamaged, the '''Lava''' can easily become an issue. The '''Lava''' can be spawned by the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]], [[Fallen Reaper]] (wave 38 onwards) and [[Molten Boss]] (on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode only). The [[Mystery]] can also spawn the '''Lava''' upon its death in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, wave 38 onwards. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Lava''' has red glowing skin, black rusted torso and legs, and metal-plated armbands. While walking, its head tilts slightly forward and it sticks out its arms. Smoke is emitted from its torso. It is about the same size as the [[Abnormal]]. |Unused |The '''Lava''' had light red glowing skin, black cobblestone torso and legs, and a metal-plated wristband on its right arm. Smoke was emitted from its torso. }} ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Do not give time for the '''Lava''' to heal its health back. **Make sure that you concentrate all damage to them at once. If you spread out damage across the map, the '''Lava''' will have more time to heal its health back. **The [[Railgun Tank]] can collide with the '''Lava''', instantly killing it or leaving it severely weakened. This reduces the efficiency of the '''Lava''' healing back its lost health. **Splash damage towers such as the [[Mortar]] can be quite effective against this, as they can hit multiple '''Lavas''' at once. *Fast firing towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]], can be used to constantly attack the '''Lava''', preventing it healing back any health. **The [[Ranger]] can also be used. However, do be aware that the '''Lava''' can heal back its health between shots due to its slow firerate. ***The [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability is highly recommended as it allows them to quickly deal damage towards the '''Lava'''. *Despite being a fire enemy, it is not immune to the [[Pyromancer]] which can mitigate the regeneration effect the '''Lava''' has. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Lava2.png|Unused version (15 August 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLava.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} OldEnemiesLeak.png|Unused '''Lava''' on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexLava.png|'''Lava''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *There was an unused variant '''Lava''' that was added on the 15th of August 2019 and removed in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], but did not appear naturally. **It was meant to be added to the game proper, alongside the [[Frozen (Pre-MEGA)|Frozen]] and [[Deep Freeze (Pre-MEGA)|Deep Freeze]], but this was cancelled. **Therefore, the '''Lava''' could only be spawned by commands. **This version of the '''Lava''' could also regenerate health, similar to the current version. ***It also had similar statistics, but it had 1,000 health instead of 700 and had [[Burn Immunity]]. ***This was similar to the [[Molten]]'s ability at the time, which could also regenerate health. *Although both [[enemies]] bear no resemblance to each other, the '''Lava's''' regeneration ability is similar to that of the [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]]. *Despite being a fire elemental enemy, the '''Lava''' does not have [[Burn Immunity]]. *The '''Lava''' looks similar to the old [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Lava|Lava]] from ''Tower Battles''. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Lava''' added. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Lava''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{Hardcore|[[Grave Digger]]|Wave 36|Lava|Wave 37|[[Lead Balloon]]|Wave 39|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
